Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are walking out to the middle now. Litton Das and Anamul Haque are the two opners for Bangladesh. Mohammed Siraj to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India have posted a huge total on the board thanks to the destruction from Ishan Kishan and the calmness of Virat Kohli. They will be the happier side going into the break and will be confident enough to defend this. Bangladesh, on the other hand needs to do something really special to chase this down. Let's see how things pan out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Ishan Kishan, the man of the moment is up for a chat. He says that he is grateful for the opportunity and the wicket was too good to bat on and he just wanted to jump on it. Adds that he feels blessed to be in the company of such great players and is unhappy that he got out with 15 overs remaining and wanted to get to 300. Mentions that batting with Virat Kohli made his job easier as Kohli kept on calming him down and his intent was to just go for it. Says that he had a chat with Suryakumar Yadav before the game and he wanted to just make the most of this opportunity.

Bangladesh will be very disappointed with their effort with the ball. They did get an early wicket, but then looked clueless and out of sorts when Ishan Kishan and Virat Kohli were batting. They were taken to the cleaners and everyone of them were expensive and could not find the breakthrough. The were a bit sloppy in the field as they dropped a couple of good chances which costed them dearly. However, they did pull things back a bit in the death overs by picking up wickets at regular intervals, but it will be a tough ask for them to chase this down. As they have already bagged the series, they don't have to think about the result and can play freely when they get back on the field. Taskin Ahmed, Ebadot Hossain and Shakib Al Hasan got a couple of wickets each which helped them restrict India under 410.

India have dominated with the blade here. They started a bit slow and lost Shikhar Dhawan quite early, but once Ishan Kishan got the hold of the pitch, he was unstoppable. He absolutely smashed it all around the park and spared no bowler. He scored his first ODI hundred, but did not stop there. He continued his destruction and reached his double-hundred in no time. However, he was well supported by Virat Kohli on the other end, who himself scored a century after being dropped on one by Litton Das. Both of them added 290 runs for the second wicket. Kishan got dismissed on 210, and India lost their way a bit after that, losing wickets in quick succession. At one point of time they were looking set to reach the 450-mark, but the flurry of wickets meant that they fell short of that. Washington Sundar played a good hand at the end and helped India get to 409. This is still a huge score, and their bowlers will have the freedom to try out different things while defending this total.

Take a bow, Ishan Kishan! We have seen one of the best inning in ODI cricket history. He also becomes the fastest batter to score a double-century in this format surpassing the record held by Chris Gayle.

Another dot to finish! Slower one, very full and well outside off stump. Mohammed Siraj has to reach for it but yet again he fails to get any bat on it. The batters decide against the bye and India finish with 409/8 on the board!
Swing and a miss! Very full and close to the off stump, angling across. Mohammed Siraj swings wildly at it but fails to connect.
Mohammed Siraj is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mustafizur Rahman gets his first wicket of the game now. This is the cutter and it is bowled on a fuller length around off stump. Shardul Thakur stays deep in his crease and lofts it down to long on. Litton Das over there takes a simple catch and India lose their eighth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around middle, flicked away aerially towards deep square leg for one more.

Good deception from the bowler. Pitches it up now around off stump but takes pace off the ball. Shardul Thakur is on the front foot and ends up just lobbing it off the face of the bat around wide mid off. They get a single.
Good length outside off, Kuldeep Yadav opens the face of the blade and guides it down to third man for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman (9-0-63-0) to bowl the final over.
On a length and around off, Kuldeep Yadav looks for the reverse paddle and gets it down to short third man for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav walks out to bat now. There is also a slight halt as one of the stumps at the striker's end seems to be broken. The umpire has indicated for a replacement. We are ready to continue.

OUT! BOWLED! Shakib Al Hasan does get his man in the end but Washington Sundar has done his job well. This is a bit shorter from over the stumps and turning it in from off stump. Sundar walks past the off stump and looks to flick it away. The ball skids through and takes the inside edge before going on to hit the stumps.

FOUR! Oh, dear! The fielder has made a mess of it. A full toss around off stump, Washington Sundar slogs it flat and towards deep mid-wicket. Afif Hossain comes in from the deep but misjudges the flight completely and the ball goes through him for a boundary.
WIDE! Flatter one, trying to angle it across the left-hander but it is just too wide.
Around off, Shardul Thakur leans forward and drives it through covers for a single. This brings up the 400 for India now!
Floated up well wide of the off stump, Thakur can only manage to play it back to the bowler.
Leg bye! Tossed up down the leg side, Washington Sundar looks for the slog-sweep but misses. The ball goes off the pads and towards backward square leg for a leg bye.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl the penultimate over.
A low full toss outside off, Sundar thumps it down to long on for just one run.
Slower one, this time it's fuller and around off, Sundar guides it towards short third man.
SIX! BOOM! Slower one, back of a length and over middle. Washington Sundar picks it up early and waits on the back foot before pulling it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
This is banged in short and outside off, Shardul Thakur pulls it in front of mid-wicket for one.
Who will walk out now?

OUT! DRAGGED ON! A bit of reprive here for Taskin Ahmed. Fullish length, slower and pushed a bit further across the off stump. Axar Patel is on the back foot as he throws his hands at it. Axar falls over a bit and ends up dragging the ball off the inisde edge and onto the stumps.
SIX! Just over! Good length around off, Axar Patel hangs deep and flat-bats it towards long on. The fielder over there leaps up but the ball sails over for a maximum.
Taskin Ahmed (8-1-75-1) is back on.
Full and around off, this is driven down to long off for a run.
Slower one, on a length and around off. Sundar has to wait an eternity for it and ends up pulling it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Skillful from Washington Sundar. Mustafizur Rahman misses the yorker on middle and ends up serving a full toss. Sundar walks across his stumps and ramps it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
back of a length and around off, Sundar goes up and over cover-point and picks up a couple of runs.
Top delivery! Mustafizur Rahman nails the toe-crushing yorker and Sundar does well to get a bat on it.
Slower one on a good length and angling in from outside off. Washington Sundar has a swipe across the line but is well beaten.
Pulls back the length and bowls it around the pads, this is eased off the back foot through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off stump, this is played through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! This is poor bowling from Mahmudullah. Another short delivery outside off, Axar Patel cuts it off the back foot and beats the deep point fielder to his right to find the fence.
Pushed through quicker and around off, Axar Patel blocks it out.
Tossed up around middle, this is pushed down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Starts off with a short and wide one, Washington Sundar waits on the back foot and cuts it away behind point for a boundary.
Mahmudullah has been tossed the ball now.
Full again and on off, Washington Sundar drives it towards covers for a single. Six singles in the over.
Fuller one, on leg, Axar Patel flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for another run.
Back of a length and on leg, Washington Sundar nudges it through mid-wicket for a run.
Goes fuller and on leg, Axar Patel works it through square leg for one more.
Short again and on off, Washington Sundar bunts it onto the ground and gets a quick single.
Short of a length and outside off, Axar Patel cuts it through point for a single.
Another dot as this full delivery is defended to the off side.
Floated, full and on middle, Washington Sundar blocks it out.
Shorter in length and on leg, Washington Sundar moves back and tucks it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Washington Sundar pushes it towards covers.
Flatter, full and on middle, Axar Patel flicks it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Axar Patel works it with the inner half through mid-wicekt for a brace.
Back of a length and on the pads, Axar Patel tucks it through square leg for a run.
This is on a yokrer length and on off, Axar Patel squeezes it out towards mid off.
Fuller and on the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for one.
Nicely bowled! Another slower one, on a length and angling across the off stump. Washington Sundar gets completely squared up and beaten past the outside edge.
Slower one, full and on the pads, Sundar clips it 'round the corner and comes back for two with ease.
FOUR! What a shot! Good length around off, Washington Sundar leans on and caresses it through extra cover to pick up a boundary. The 350 is now up for India.
Looped up, full and around leg, Washington Sundar flicks it towards deep square leg for one.
Flighted, full and on middle, Axar Patel eases it toward long on for a single and gets off the mark.
Quicker one, on middle, turning in, Axar Patel defends it on the front foot.
Floated, full and on leg, Axar Patel works it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up, full and on off, Axar Patel blocks it out.
Axar Patel is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Virat Kohli goes now! Shakib Al Hasan gets the crucial wicket and Bangladesh have pulled things back slightly. This is tossed up and outside off, Virat Kohli skips down the track and goes for the big shot over wide long off, but hits it with bottom part of the bat and it goes much straighter. Mehidy Hasan there takes a brilliant catch running to his left. A good inning from Kohli comes to an end, but he has put India in a strong position to post a big total.
Commentary.Howout: c Mehidy Hasan b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Shakib Al Hasan (8-0-59-0) is back into the attack.
This is full and on middle, Washington Sundar knocks it towards mid on.
Washington Sundar is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! Ebadot Hossain strikes now! A brilliant delivery and KL Rahul loses his stumps. After keeping the length short in the previous two deliveries, Ebadot Hossain naisl the yorker this time, on off, KL Rahul is expecting the short ball again, and is very late to put his bat down to block it. The ball goes through to shatter the stumps. India four down now!
Slower delivery again, short and on middle, KL Rahul is early into his flick and misses it completely.
FOUR! KL Rahul connects this time! Ebadot Hossain lands this short again and on middle, KL Rahul pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length and on middle, KL Rahul goes for the pull shot, but misses and gets hit around his lower stomach area.
A slower one, on a length and outside off, Virat Kohli slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Powerplay 3! Now, fives fielders are allowed outside the circle till the last over.
Short of a length and around leg stump, Kohli works it away down to fine leg for a run.
Pitched up around off, played away to deep point for one.
Fullish delivery around off, KL Rahul drives it straight to mid off.
Back of a length and on leg stump, Rahul dabs it down towards backward square leg.
Fuller and angling across the right-hander, this is stroked away through cover-point for one.
SIX! Length ball around middle, Virat Kohli skips down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball before lofting it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Mustafizur Rahman (6-0-40-0) comes back into the attack.
Back of a length and around off, Rahul blocks it out on the off side.

Well in! Good length over middle, this is punched away towards short mid-wicket for a quick single. The bowler picks up the ball and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end but Kohli has made his ground.

SIX! The wait is finally over for Virat Kohli and he gets to his 44th ODI hundred, his first since August 2019 that too in style. Poor line from Ebadot, length ball down the leg side, Kohli picks it up and clips it all the way over the fine leg fence for a biggie. Kohli celebrates with a cheeky smile on his face and also goes past former Australian skipper Ricky Ponting in terms of international hundreds and he is now only second to Sachin Tendulkar on that list.
Good length on the pads, this is tucked away down to fine leg for one.
Excellent running! Pitched up outside off, this is played on the up and past the man at point. The man in the deep is a bit slow to get to the ball and the batters race back for the second.
KL Rahul comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! A ripper of a catch from Litton Das and after dropping a simple one early in the innings, the skipper has taken two beautiful catches. Ebadot Hossain goes full and wide, Shreyas Iyer stays deep in his crease and looks to thrash it through the cover region. The connection is a firm one but it is hit uppishly and straight towards short cover. Das has almost no time to react but he is able to grab it with both hands in front of his chest.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Ebadot Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Slows it up now and flights it on off stump, Virat Kohli strides forward to defend.
This is angled into middle and leg, Kohli blocks it out.
A tad shorter and around off, Shreyas Iyer pushes it off the back foot and through covers for one more.
Around off stump, driven through wide mid off for a single.
FOUR! Had all the time in the world to put that one away. Dragged down around leg stump, Kohli rocks back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
This is drifted in on a nagging length and around middle, Kohli gets pushed onto the back foot and keeps it out.
Shakib Al Hasan (7-0-53-0) comes back into the attack.
Back of a length and outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Virat Kohli and he now moves into the 90s. Pitched up around off, Kohli plays a high-elbow drive and smokes it through extra cover for a boundary.
The call is for two and they get it with ease. Good length and outside off, this is hammered away through the cover region for a couple of runs.
Back of a length and around off, Iyer forces the pull shot towards mid on and scampers through for a quick run.
Good length again around off, Iyer gets a bit squared up and ends up getting a leading edge towards point.
Beaten! Good length, in that channel around off. Iyer looks to have a poke at it but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Ebadot Hossain (5-0-49-0) is back on.
Shorter and down leg, Shreyas Iyer works it off his hips down to fine leg for a single.
Shreyas Iyer walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! End of a fine, fine inning from Ishan Kishan and he is absolutely distraught here. On a hard length and around middle from Taskin Ahmed, Kishan backs away and looks to pump this one down the ground. One hand comes off the handle and the ball is skied right back over the bowler's head. Fielders from long off and long on both converge but it is Litton Das from long on who gets to it first and completes an excellent running catch. Take a bow, Ishan Kishan and he receives a well-deserved standing ovation as he walks back to the crease.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BOOM! A length ball around middle and leg, Ishan Kishan dispatches this one a long, long way over the mid-wicket fence for a huge hit. The 300 is up now for India.
Beaten all ends up! A slower one, full and well outside off, Kishan throws his hands at it but fails to connect.
Shorter and around leg stump, this is pulled off the hips but straight towards short fine leg.
FOUR! A low full toss outside off, Ishan Kishan is able to get under it yet again and smashes it over extra cover to find the fence.

A double hundred to savour for young Ishan Kishan and he runs away in celebration, rightly so. What a gargantuan effort this has been from him and his partner at the other end is up in celebration as well. This is very full around off, Kishan squeezes it out towards cover for a quick single and takes off his helmet as he takes in the applause from the crowd. He looks far from done as well and would be eyeing the all-time ODI record for an individual player which incidentally is held by the man who he has replaced in this match.
Pitches it up again and outside off, Kohli drives it uppishly through mid off and turns the strike over to the man on 199.
Slower one around off, Kishan forces it off the back foot towards mid off and completes a quick run.
Pitched up around off, just stroked away through covers for a single.
A low full toss outside off, this is driven well in front of the square on the off side. The fielder from deep point runs around and the batters take just the single.
Full and angling well across the off stump, Kohli comes down the track and drives it down the ground for one.
FOUR! Just one hit away now from a monumental double ton. Fuller one outside off, Ishan Kishan smashes it away over mid off and picks up yet another boundary.
Full and around off, this is driven square of the wicket to deep cover-point for a single.
Short and wide, Kohli has to reach for it a bit and ends up just tapping it towards point.
FOUR! Glorious from Virat Kohli. Overpitched around off with no protection in the deep in front of square on the off side. Kohli gets under it and lofts it over the extra cover for a boundary.
Gets it in the blockhole this time, and Kishan digs it out towards mid off for a run.

FOUR! Slashed away. Looking for the wide yorker but it ends up being a low full toss. Ishan Kishan looks to go over covers but slices it over backward point as the ball runs away into the fence. He gets into the 190s now.
Very full and on off stump, this is driven down to long on for one.
Excellent running! Slower one, around the top of off, Kohli nudges it towards point and sets off for a quick single.
A full toss now outside off, Virat Kohli drives it over wide mid off. The fielder from long off runs around and keeps it down to a couple of runs.
Well bowled! Mustafizur Rahman sees Ishan Kishan advancing and finds the blockhole around middle and leg. Kishan jams it out on the off side for a single.
Very full and on leg stump, Kohli clips it away in front of mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
A slower yorker now, around off and angling across. Virat Kohli looks to smash it through cover but is undone by the lack of pace.
Well bowled! Taskin Ahmed nails the wide yorker and Ishan Kishan is beaten for pace.
Miscued but lands safely! This is pitched up around off, Kishan looks to get under it but ends up slicing it high and over wide mid off for a couple of runs.
Short of a length and it is the slower one. Kohli uses his wrists to pull it well in front of square on the leg side but only for a single.

FOUR! Banged in short and outside off. Virat Kohli holds his shape and just lofts it off the back foot and whacks it over wide mid off for another boundary. The 250-run stand is up between these two as well.

Kishan getting a bit too excited there. back of a length and angling in from around off. Kohli dabs it down to point and once again Kishan is halfway down the track. Kohli sends him back in time though.
FOUR! Kohli's best shot of the day for sure. Length ball outside off, Kohli thrashes it on the up and wide of the man at deep point to pick up a boundary.
WIDE! Starts off with a bouncer around off stump and it is just a bit too high for the umpire's liking.

Drinks! Ishan Kishan is playing like a man on a mission. He will be eying that double-hundred now and to do that while batting with Virat Kohli will be special for him. Bangladesh bowlers are having a tough time out there and they are in a lot of toruble. They need to break this partnership and pickup a few more wickets to avoid India getting to total of over 400. Taskin Ahmed to bowl after the break.

Almost went onto the stumps! Good length around the top of off, Virat Kohli chops it off the bottom edge and the ball goes agonizingly past the off stump. Kishan is halfway down the track and they do manage to squeeze in the single.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Mustafizur Rahman and Virat Kohli just punishes it. Slower one again, short and around leg stump. Kohli pulls it aerially and well behind the man at deep square leg for a boundary.
Full and straight, driven down to long on for a single.

FOUR! A bit of finesse from Ishan Kishan this time around. A slower bumper outside off, Kishan waits for it and just chops it off the face of the bat over the keeper's head and picks up yet another boundary.
Very full and around off, jammed out towards extra cover.
Starts off with a length ball on middle, Virat Kohli punches it down to mid off for a quick single.
Mustafizur Rahman (3-0-17-0) is back on.
FOUR! Two in a row! This is tossed up, full and on off, Ishan Kishan goes inside out and lofts it over extra covers for another boundary.
FOUR! SMASHED! Mehidy Hasan lands this short again and on off, Ishan Kishan swats it oevr the bowler's head for a boundary.
Short and on middle, Virat Kohli nudges it through square leg for one.
Flatter, full and outside off, Ishan Kishan drags his sweep towards long on for one.
SIX! This one has gone into the stands! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan onces again nails his slog-sweep over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Floated, full and on middle, Virat Kohli uses his feet and works it towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Ishan Kishan is absolutely smashing it all around the park! This is short and outside off, Ishan Kishan goes for the pull, but loses the grip as he hits the ball. It still has the power to go over mid on for a boundary.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off, Virat Kohli knocks it towards mid off for one.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Kohli! Ebadot Hossain bowls a low full toss, on off, Virat Kohli stays there and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary.
This is pitched up and outside off, Ishan Kishan drills it wide of mid off for one more.
On a length and on off, Virat Kohli pushes it towards covers for a run.
This is on yorker length and on the pads, Ishan Kishan works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Ebadot Hossain (4-0-37-0) is back on.
Floated up around off, Kishan slogs this one away down to long on for just a single.
Flatter delivery, angling into the pads, Kishan looks to flick but gets an inside edge off the pads and towards short third man.

FOUR! Tossed up full and around middle, Ishan Kishan skips down the track and drills it right back past the bowler for yet another boundary. This is absolute carnage from Kishan. The 200-run stand is also up between these two.
150 FOR KISHAN! He has reached it in style as well! This is floated, full and on leg, Ishan Kishan goes down and sweeps it over the fine leg fence for a biggie. Can he score the double-hundred here?

FIFTY FOR KOHLI! He has played second fiddle to Kishan, but it has been a great supporting knock. This is floated, full and on middle, Virat Kohli drills it towards long on for a single. He will aslo try to make this one a big innings from here.
Short and on off, Virat Kohli pushes it towards covers.
Floated, full and on middle, Virat Kohli strokes it towards long on for a single.
Short again and outisde off, Ishan Kishan lofts this one with one-hand, but it lands safely in front of long off. They cross.
SIX! Kishan is clearing the ropes with ease here! This is short and on off, Ishan Kishan moves on his back foot and pulls it over the deep mid-wicekt fence for a biggie.
Flatter, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan mistimes his slog-sweep towards deep square leg for a brace.
SIX! Ishan Kishan sends this one over the fence! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan skips down the track and heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Shakib Al Hasan follows the batter and bowls this full and on leg, Ishan Kishan makes room and still manages to smash it over covers for a boundary.
Ebadot Hossain bowls a good yorker, outside off, Virat Kohli tries to play at it, but misses.
Full and outside off, keeps it away from the batter, Ishan Kishan drives it through covers for a single.
SIX! Another huge hit! This is full and on off, in the slot as well, Ishan Kishan stays in his crease and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
This is on a yorker length and on off, Virat Kohli drills it through cover-point for a run.
A low full toss and outside off, Ishan Kishan slices it towards deep backward point for a single.
SIX! BOOM! Ishan Kishan is dealing in boundaries here! Ebadot Hossain lands this short and on middle, Ishan Kishan swivels and pulls it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Short and on middle, Ishan Kishan eases it towards long on for a run.
Darts this one full and on leg, Ishan Kishan goes for the slog-sweep again, but misses and gets hit on the pads.
SIX! BANG! This is looped up, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan goes down and slog-sweeps it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan knocks it back to the bowler.
Flatter and down the leg side, Ishan Kishan goes for the switch-hit, but mistimes it towards point.
Shorter and outside off, cut away off the back foot to deep point for a single.
Shortish and on middle, Virat Kohli works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short again and outside off, Ishan Kishan slices it uppishly, but it falls well in front of long off. They cross.
FOUR! Powered away! This is bit short and on off, Ishan Kishan stays there and thrashes it towards the wide long off fence for a boundary.
Quicker, full and on middle, Virat Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it away wide of long on for three runs.
Floated and outside off, Ishan Kishan forces it towards long off for a single.

FOUR! HUNDRED FOR KISHAN! He roars in delight! This has been an excellent innings from him and he will now look to add more runs to his tally. This is tossed up, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan goes down and sweeps it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Afif Hossain has been brought into the attack now.
A single to end the over as this short delivery is punched down the ground to long on by Kishan.
Flighted, on middle, Virat Kohli uses his feet and nudges it towards mid-wicket for one.
Floated, full and on off, Ishan Kishan drives it towards long off for a run.
Quicker, short and on leg, Ishan Kishan flicks it towards short fine leg.
A bit short and on leg, Virat Kohli goes back and pushes it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Virat Kohli finds the fence! This is tossed up and around off, Virat Kohli skips down the track and chips it over extra cover for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Virat Kohli drills it towards long on for onre more.
Floated and on middle, Ishan Kishan strokes it towards long on for one.
Short again and middle, Virat Kohli tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on off, Virat Kohli punches it towards covers.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished! This is short and on middle, Virat Kohli goes on his back foot and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Darts this one full and on the pads, Ishan Kishan works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and on middle, Virat Kohli knocks it towards short covers where Litton Das stops it and saves the single.
Flighted, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan goes for the slog-sweep but gets an inside edge through square leg for another run.
Short again and on off, Virat Kohli uses his feet and pushes it through covers for one.
Floated, short and on middle, Ishan Kishan eases it towards long on for a one more.
A bit short and on middle, Virat Kohli forces it towards long on for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Ishan Kishan drives it towards long off for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on.

Tossed up around middle, Kishan advances and hits it firmly towards mid on before setting off for the single. The fielder over there scores a direct hit at the bowler's end and the third umpire is called into action. The replays show that Kishan made his ground with ease.
FOUR! This is dragged down around middle, Ishan Kishan pulls it off the back foot and hits it dead straight. The fielder from long off is unable to get to it and it will be another boundary.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Kohli leans forward and drives it through mid on for a single.

Shakib Al Hasan almost pulled off a one-in-a-million catch. Ishan Kishan pre-meditates and shuffles across the leg stump, Mehidy Hasan follows him with a shortish delivery. Kishan pulls it towards wide long on. Shakib runs around from deep mid-wicket and dives full stretch to his right trying to grab it with one hand. The ball pops up and hits his arm and then the turf before finally being held with the left hand. The catch is checked and the soft signal is not out and it stays that way. Just the single then.
FOUR! Tossed up on a length and outside off, Kishan gets low and slogs it away in front of mid-wicket for a boundary.
Well bowled. Ishan Kishan dances down the track and looks to go big but Mehidy Hasan spears it into the toes. Kishan checks his shot and jams it out.

FOUR! Finally, Virat Kohli is able to find the fence. Overpitched on middle and leg, Kohli thumps it uppishly and to the left of the fielder at mid on for a boundary. The 100-run stand is up between these two as well.
Shortish delivery over leg stump, this is tucked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely bowled. Full and straight but all the pace is taken off the ball. Ishan Kishan just leans on and blocks it out.
Back of a length and around off, Kohli taps it towards point where the fielder makes a half stop and allows the single.

Is that a catch? Doesn't look like it as Litton Das isn't excited but the umpires take it upstairs. The soft signal is not out. Mustafizur Rahman pitches it up now outside off, Virat Kohli goes hard at it and looks to smash it over mid off but gets it off the toe end of the bat. Litton Das dives forward and grabs it but the replays clearly show that the ball bounced into his hands. Kohli is let off the hook once again.
Mustafizur Rahman comes back into the attack and starts off with a length ball on off stump. Virat Kohli solidly blocks it off the front foot.
Kishan looks to step out but Mehidy fires it in at the toes. This is played towards short extra cover.
FOUR! Swept away! Good length around middle and leg, Ishan Kishan gets inside the line of the ball and brooms it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Pulls the length back and angles it into the pads, Kishan blocks it out.
Tossed up on leg stump, Kohli advances and lofts it down to long on for a single.
Pushed through quicker and around off, Kohli punches it out to mid on.
Drifts it onto the pads, Virat Kohli flicks it away towards fine leg and races back for the second with ease. Good running.

Drinks! India lost Shikhar Dhawan early, but Ishan Kishan and Virat Kohli have built a good partnership where the former is scoring runs at a good rate. Kishan will be eyeing that hundred now. Bangladesh need wickets to get back in the game. Another exciting session of cricket awaits us.

FOUR! In complete control of that shot. Back of a length but the pace is taken off the delivery. This is around the hips, Kishan gets inside the line of the ball and stylishly flicks it over short fine leg for a boundary. The 100 is now up for India.
A good bumper this from Taskin, over leg stump and Kishan ducks under it well.
SIX! BANG! Ishan Kishan is on fire out there. Just a fraction short and around middle. Kishan picks up the length early and pulls it off the back foot over cow corner for a biggie.
Fuller and on the pads, this is tucked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Hard length and pushed well outside off, Kohli looks to hammer it down the ground but mistimes it towards mid on.
Back of a length around off, Kohli stands tall and punches it towards cover.

FOUR! Lovely use of the feet from Ishan Kishan on this occasion. Mehidy Hasan tosses it up outside off, Kishan dances down the track and backs away before lofting it inside-out over extra cover. The ball almost travels the distance but it will be a boundary.
Pushed through quicker and into the pads, Kohli flicks it well in front of mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is driven through mid on for a run.
Floated up full and drifting onto middle and leg, Kishan backs away and eases it back to the bowler.
On a length and angling into the pads, Kohli wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up on a length, Kohli looks to use his feet but ends up just defending it onto the leg side.

Kishan pre-meditates and backs away, Taskin follows him with a short ball. Kishan connects the pull shot well but the fielder at deep square leg makes a brilliant diving stop to his left. A couple of runs are taken.
FOUR! This is very full and wide of the off stump, Ishan Kishan throws his hands at it and is able to thump it over the extra cover region for a boundary. Kishan looks all set for a big one here.
Length ball, around off and angling in. Kohli punches it on the up and through covers for a run.
Good length around off, Ishan Kishan looks to cut but ends up chopping it off the face of the bat and down to third man for a single.
Length again angling it into the pads, Kohli works it 'round the corner and rotates the strike.
Slower delivery, on a length and around off, Kishan waits for it and steers it past backward point for a single.
WIDE! Taskin Ahmed starts the new spell with a bumper over the stumps. This is just a bit too high and a wide is called.
Taskin Ahmed (3-1-16-0) replaces Shakib Al Hasan.
Tosses one up now around off, Kishan pushes it through mid off and picks up a single.
And again! Angling into middle and leg, pushes out towards the bowler.
Four dots in a row now. Around middle and leg, just stopping a bit on the batter, Kishan pushes it uppishly back to the bowler.
Mehidy just slides this one into leg stump but Kishan yet again pats it back to the bowler.
On a length and angling it into middle and leg, Kishan blocks it out.
Nicley held back by Mehidy Hasan, around off stump, Ishan Kishan watchfully keeps it out.
Mehidy Hasan (2-0-8-1) comes back into the attack.
Floated up on a length, Virat Kohli works it off the back foot and wide of the man at long on for a couple of runs.
That one kept low. This is bowled flatter and angled in, the ball keeps low and Kohli does well to keep it out.
Quicker one, sliding it into leg stump, Kishan forces it off the back foot and towards long on for one more.
Nicely flighted and on a nagging length, Kohli leans forward and is able to uppishly clip it down the ground for another single.
That's FIFTY for Ishan Kishan and this has been a blistering knock from him, his 4th fifty in ODIs. Flighted and on middle, Kishan comes forward and eases it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up full and outside off, Kohli hits it square of the wicket towards sweeper cover and picks up a single.

FOUR! Not perfectly timed but well enough. Good length on off stump, Kishan looks to smash it back past the bowler but mistimes it. The outfield is quick and the ball beats the diving fielder at mid on for a boundary. 18 off the over, a big one for India.
SIX! Classy shot from the southpaw. This is short and around the hips, Kishan picks it up and pulls it all the way over the man at deep square leg for a maximum.
This is pitched up around off, Kishan punches it towards extra cover. Kohli wants the single but Kishan denies it.
FOUR LEG BYES! Erring in line here Ebadot. This is bowled at 141 clicks and down the leg side, Kishan looks to flick but the ball comes off the thigh pads and runs away into the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Cut away! Just a fraction shorter and around off, Ishan Kishan cuts it late and behind backward point for a boundary. The 50 is now up for India.
Ebadot bowls this fuller and around leg stump and angling across, Kishan pushes it out on the off side.
This is flatter and skidding on with the arm. Virat Kohli gets pegged back as he tries to block but gets hit on the pads outside the line of leg stump.
Nicely drifted into middle, Kishan leans on and strokes it towards long off for a single.
This is around middle and off, Kohli pushes it through mid off for one more.
Chipped but into the gap. Shakib Al Hasan slows it up and floats it around middle. Ishan Kishan is drawn forward and ends up just lofting it over mid on for a run.
Tossed up around off, this is eased down to long off for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Virat Kohli hits it hard but straight towards cover.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
This is on a length and on off, Ishan Kishan blocks it with the outer half towards covers.
Full and on leg, Ishan Kishan knocks it towards mid on.
In the air....safe! Ebadot Hossain bangs this short, on middle, Ishan Kishan goes for the pull shot, but mistimes it. Luckily for him it lands safely in the deep mid-wicket region. Two runs taken!
On a length and on off, Ishan Kishan taps it to the off side.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Virat Kohli drives it towards covers who makes a good stop diving to his left. They cross.
Full and on middle, Virat Kohli miscues his drive towards mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Ishan Kishan is solid in his defense again.
Gives this one some air, on middle, Ishan Kishan leans on and blocks it out.
Looped up, full and on off, Virat Kohli uses his feet and drives it towards long off for a run.
Short and on middle, Ishan Kishan moves back and forces it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off, Ishan Kishan drives it towards covers.
Floated, short and on middle, turning in, Ishan Kishan pushes it with the leading edge towards the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan replaces Mehidy Hasan now.
Full and on off, Ishan Kishan knocks it with soft hand towards mid off and gets across for a quick single.
FOUR! Nice placement! Ebadot Hossain lands this short and on middle, Ishan Kishan gets into position quickly and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Four dots in a row! This is short and outside off, Ishan Kishan cuts it straight to point.
On a length and around leg, Ishan Kishan helps it towards short fine leg.
Short of a length and on off, Ishan Kishan defends it to the off side.
Ebadot Hossain starts with a full delivery, on off, Ishan Kishan blocks it out.
Ebadot Hossain is brought into the attack now.
Short and on off, Ishan Kishan slaps it towards long off for a run.
Looped up, full and on middle, Virat Kohli eases it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! A streaky boundary! Mehidy Hasan slows this one up, on middle, turining in, Virat Kohli uses his feet and goes for the heave, but hits it with the inner half past square leg for a boudnary.
DROPPED! This is flighted, full and on middle, Virat Kohli flicks it uppishly towards short-mid-wicket where Litton Das drops a sitter moving to his left. This could prove to be costly.
Floated around middle, Virat Kohli nudges it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up, full and on off, Virat Kohli knocks it towards mid off.
Short and outisde off, Ishan Kishan guides it wide of third man for a couple of runs.
Back of a length and outside off, Ishan Kishan dabs it towards point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Taskin Ahmed serves this fuller and outside off, Ishan Kishan strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Length again, on middle and leg, angling in, Ishan Kishan knocks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length and around leg, Ishan Kishan flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Good shot! Tamim Iqbal bowls this short of a length and outside off, Ishan Kishan accepts the width and cuts it through point for a boundary.
This is served around middle, Virat Kohli is able to block it out. Just 2 runs and a wicket off Mehidy's first over.
Floated up, full and around middle, Ishan Kishan pushes it to the left of the diving bowler for a quick run.
A slight fumble and Virat Kohli is off the mark. This is tossed up on the pads, Kohli flicks it towards square leg for a single.
This is pushed through quicker and on off stump, Virat Kohli keeps it out.
This is flighted up on a length and around off, Virat Kohli defends it out on the off side.
Virat Kohli walks in at number 3.

OUT! Mehidy Hasan strikes on his very first ball! Shikhar Dhawan goes for another low score. Mehidy Hasan comes around the wicket and bowls a flatter delivery, on middle, skidding through, Shikhar Dhawan looks to block it out, but misses and gets hit on the pads. The bat and pad are very close to each other, and it looks close. There is a huge appeal for LBW, but turned down. Litton Das takes the review. The UltraEdge shows that the ball hit the pad first. Ball Tracking shows three reds. India lose their first!
Mehidy Hasan comes on as first change.
Maiden over! Taskin Ahmed bowsl this back of a length and around leg, Ishan Kishan keeps it out again.
Five dots in a row! This is on a length and on leg, Ishan Kishan blocks it out to the leg side.
Short and on middle, Ishan Kishan is early into his pull shot and gets an inside edge onto his pads. It coulde have easily gone onto the stumps.
Taskin Ahmed bangs in a boucner, on middle and leg, Ishan Kishan ducks under it.
Back of a length and on leg, Ishan Kishan defends it to the leg side.
This is full and on middle, shaping in, Ishan Kishan works it with the inner half towards square leg.
Good running! This is on a good length and on off, angling in sharply, Ishan Kishan gets cramped and inside edges it onto the pads as the ball stays there. The batters steal a quick run.
Goes fuller this time, on off, Ishan Kishan pushes it towards covers.
On a length and on middle, Ishan Kishan blocks it to the off side.
Full again and on middle, Ishan Kishan knocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Two-in-two for Kishan! This is full and on off, Ishan Kishan stays there and drives it through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! That is the first boundary of the innings! Mustafizur Rahman bowls this short of a length and outside off, Ishan Kishan frees his arms and cuts it past point for a boundary.
Mustafizur Rahman loses his line and serves this full, but down the leg side. Ishan Kishan misses his flick. It is called a wide.
Another full delivery, on leg, Shikhar Dhawan strokes it towards mid-wicket and denies for the run.
Full and on off, angling away, Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone.
Pitched up and on the leg stump line, Ishan Kishan tucks it through square leg for one more.
Back of a length and around off, Shikhar Dhawan guides it with the outer half towards third man for a run.
This is on a hard length and on middle, shaping in, Ishan Kishan gets cramped and taps it towards point for a single and gets off the mark.
Taskin Ahmed begins with a full delivery, on the pads, Shikhar Dhawan misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Taskin Ahmed to take the other new ball.
Fuller one, on middle, Ishan Kishan pushes it back towards the bowler.
BEATEN! Mustafizur Rahman bowls this on a hard length and on off, holds it line after hitting the deck, Ishan Kishan looks to play at it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full again and on middle, Ishan Kishan knocks it towards mid on.
India and Shikhar Dhawan are underway! This is a touch fuller and on the pads, Shikhar Dhawan flicks it towards square leg for a single.
This is on a good lenght and outside off, shaping away a bit, Shikhar Dhawan lets it got to the keeper.
Mustafizur Rahman starts with a full delivery, on off, Shikhar Dhawan looks to drive it, but gets an inside edge to the leg side.

We are ready for the start of play. The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players of Bangladesh. Shikhar Dhawan and Ishan Kishan are all set to open the innings for India. Mustafizur Rahman has been handed the new ball and is raring to go. Let's play...

KL Rahul, the stand-in captain of India says that injuries do not help, but it also gives opportunity to the guys who are ready to come in. Adds that it is important to get better as individuals and get runs in different conditions. Mentions that it is a new wicket and they need to assess it and try to put pressure back on the home team. Informs they have also made two changes.

Litton Das, the skipper of Bangladesh says that they will bowl first. Adds that there is some grass on the pitch and they will look to take early wickets to put pressure on India. Informs they have made two changes.

India (Playing XI) - Ishan Kishan (In place of Rohit Sharma), Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul (C) (WK), Washington Sundar, Axar Patel, Shardul Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav (In place of Deepak Chahar), Umran Malik, Mohammed Siraj.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Anamul Haque, Litton Das (C), Yasir Ali (In place of Najmul Hossain Shanto), Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed (In for Nasum Ahmed), Mustafizur Rahman, Ebadot Hossain.
TOSS - The coin lands in favour of Bangladesh. They have elected to BOWL first.

PITCH REPORT - Anjum Chopra is pitchside. She says that the dimensions are quite similar to Mirpur and there is a green cover on the pitch. Adds that the pacers might get some help and the batters need to be watchful at the start.

India have come under heavy scrutiny given their recent form in white-ball cricket and they haven't been able to dominate opponents in the One-Day format when playing away from home. With the series already lost, the visitors will look to end the series on a high and take a bit of momentum into the Test matches. It will be interesting to see the changes made in the final game and if they do make a difference or not. Will the hosts make it 3-0? Or will India be able to make it 2-1? We shall find out. Toss and team news in a bit.

It was a nervy finish to the 2nd ODI but Mustafizur Rahman held his own on the final delivery of the game to seal the series victory. Apart from that Mehidy Hasan only improved upon his showing in the first ODI with a maiden ton and on the whole, the hosts just played better cricket in important phases of the game.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 3rd and final ODI between Bangladesh and India from Chattogram. The Bangla Tigers have taken an unassailable 2-0 lead in the series and will have one eye on a clean sweep. On the other hand India are without skipper Rohit Sharma for this game but will be looking to get a consolation win.
... MATCH DAY ...

The stage is set for the third and final ODI of what has been a very fascinating ODI series. Over the years, Bangladesh and India have played some very close and thrilling games but it has been India who have crossed the line more often than not. However, in this series, Bangladesh have shown why they are such a consistent and dangerous team in the ODI format. They have sealed the series by winning two close games and have a golden opportunity now to whitewash India in front of the passionate crowd we always see here in Bangladesh. The caravan has now moved to Chattogram from Dhaka and India will hope that they can at least finish off the series on a high and take some momentum into the Test series. The visitors though would be without their regular skipper, Rohit Sharma and both Deepak Chahar and Kuldeep Sen have also been ruled out of this final game. KL Rahul will take over the leadership role and we might see Ishan Kishan getting a go at the top of the order. Also, India’s famed batting line-up has not lived up to its billing so far and India need the likes of Virat Kohli and Shikhar Dhawan to score runs here. Shreyas Iyer played a gritty knock in the second ODI and Rohit Sharma who had a finger injury showed great fighting spirit and commitment towards his team as he managed to take the game close but failed to take India over the line. On the bowling front, India started on a positive note and restricted Bangladesh to 69 for 6 at one point in time. However, they could not find the breakthrough in the middle overs and ended up giving away the advantage. Washington Sundar was again quite accurate with his off-breaks and Umran Malik impressed once again with his rapid bullets. However, the star of this series so far has been Mehidy Hasan who has really been the difference between the two sides. In the first game, his heroic act took Bangladesh over the line after they looked down and out with 9 wickets down for 136 in a chase of 187. In the second ODI, he just looked in a different league and again took his team from a hopeless score to a winning one with a counter-attacking century. Mahmudullah also played a key role in the second ODI and overall Bangladesh bowlers have used home conditions quite well in this series. This is a chance to create history for them and we can be assured that Bangla Tigers will leave no stone unturned to complete a whitewash here. Can India finally get their act together and get their first win on this tour? Or will the Bangla Tigers roar again? Let’s find out.
